name: dictionary-cancer-genomics
description: A data dictionary for tracking participant data for a cancer research program.

tumorStagingSystem: International Neuroblastoma Risk Group Staging System
geneticDisorders: Familial Atypical Multiple Mole Melanoma Syndrome (FAMMM)
Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome (HBOC)
Hereditary Leiomyomatosis and Renal Cell Cancer (HLRCC)
exposureFrequency: Most days but not every day

schemas.name: donor
schemas.description: Core donor demographics and vital status.

fields.name: program_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the program this donor belongs to.

fields.name: submitter_donor_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the donor within this program.

fields.name: vital_status
fields.description: Donor's last known state of living or deceased.

fields.name: cause_of_death
fields.description: Cause of a donor death.

fields.name: survival_time
fields.description: Interval in days from primary diagnosis to death or last follow-up.

fields.name: primary_site
fields.description: Organ or tissue where cancer is first diagnosed, per WHO ICD-O classification.

codeList: Bones, joints and articular cartilage of limbs
Bones, joints and articular cartilage of other and unspecified sites
Connective, subcutaneous and other soft tissues
Other and ill-defined sites in lip, oral cavity and pharynx
Other and ill-defined sites within respiratory system and intrathoracic organs
Other and unspecified female genital organs
Other and unspecified major salivary glands
Other and unspecified male genital organs
Other and unspecified parts of biliary tract
Other and unspecified parts of mouth
Other and unspecified parts of tongue
Other endocrine glands and related structures
Peripheral nerves and autonomic nervous system
Spinal cord, cranial nerves, and other parts of central nervous system

fields.name: height
fields.description: Donor height in centimeters.

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Donor weight in kilograms.

fields.name: bmi
fields.description: Body mass index in kg/m².

fields.name: genetic_disorders
fields.description: Hereditary genetic disorders present in the donor.

fields.name: menopause_status
fields.description: Menopausal status at time of primary diagnosis.

fields.name: age_at_menarche
fields.description: Age in years at which the donor first experienced menstruation.

fields.name: number_of_pregnancies
fields.description: Total number of pregnancy events experienced by the donor.

fields.name: number_of_children
fields.description: Number of children the donor has birthed.

fields.name: hrt_type
fields.description: Type of hormone replacement therapy (HRT) the donor has taken or is currently taking.

fields.name: hrt_duration
fields.description: Duration in months the donor has been taking hormone replacement therapy.

fields.name: contraception_type
fields.description: Type of hormonal contraception the donor has taken or is currently taking.

fields.name: contraception_duration
fields.description: Duration in months the donor has used hormonal contraception.

fields.name: lost_to_followup_after_clinical_event_id
fields.displayName: Lost To Follow Up After Clinical Event
fields.description: Identifier of the clinical event after which the donor became lost to follow-up.

fields.name: country_of_residence_at_enrollment
fields.description: Donor's country of residence at the time of study enrollment.

schemas.name: primary_diagnosis
schemas.description: Cancer diagnosis details and clinical TNM staging.

fields.name: submitter_primary_diagnosis_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this diagnosis within the program.

fields.name: age_at_diagnosis
fields.description: Age of the donor at the time of primary diagnosis (years).

fields.name: cancer_type_code
fields.description: ICD-10 code for the cancer type.

fields.name: cancer_type_additional_information
fields.description: Additional details about the cancer type not captured by the ICD-10 code.

codeList: No lymph nodes found in resected specimen

fields.name: lymph_nodes_examined_method
fields.displayName: Method Used to Examine Lymph Nodes

fields.name: number_lymph_nodes_examined
fields.description: Total number of lymph nodes tested for the presence of cancer.

fields.name: number_lymph_nodes_positive
fields.description: Number of regional lymph nodes positive for tumour metastases.

fields.name: clinical_tumour_staging_system
fields.description: Tumour staging system used to stage the cancer at the time of primary diagnosis, prior to treatment.

fields.name: clinical_t_category
fields.description: Extent of the primary tumour (T) based on clinical assessment at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: clinical_n_category
fields.description: Regional lymph node involvement (N) based on clinical assessment at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: clinical_m_category
fields.description: Extent of distant metastasis (M) based on clinical assessment at time of primary diagnosis and prior to treatment.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected clinical_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: clinical_stage_group
fields.description: Overall clinical stage group assigned by the selected tumour staging system.

fields.name: performance_status
fields.description: Donor's ECOG performance status grade at the time of primary diagnosis.

fields.name: submitter_primary_diagnosis_id
fields.description: The primary diagnosis event this specimen acquisition is related to.

codeList: Cell line - derived from xenograft tumour
Metastatic tumour - metastasis local to lymph node
Metastatic tumour - metastasis to distant location
Normal - tissue adjacent to primary tumour
Xenograft - derived from tumour cell line

fields.name: specimen_acquisition_interval
fields.description: Interval in days between primary diagnosis and specimen acquisition.

fields.name: specimen_anatomic_location
fields.description: ICD-O-3 topography code for the anatomic location of the specimen.

fields.name: tumour_histological_type
fields.description: ICD-O-3 morphology code for tumour histological type. Required for tumour specimens.

fields.name: specimen_laterality
fields.description: For cancer in a paired organ, the side on which the specimen was obtained.

fields.name: specimen_processing
fields.description: Technique used to process the specimen.

codeList: Cryopreservation of live cells in liquid nitrogen

fields.name: specimen_storage
fields.description: Method of specimen storage for specimens not extracted freshly or immediately cultured.

fields.name: reference_pathology_confirmed
fields.description: Whether the pathological diagnosis was confirmed by a reference pathologist.

fields.name: pathological_tumour_staging_system
fields.description: Tumour staging system used to assess the cancer at the time the tumour specimen was resected.

fields.name: pathological_t_category
fields.description: Size or contiguous extension of the primary tumour (T), per the pathological staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected pathological_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: pathological_n_category
fields.description: Regional lymph node involvement (N), per the pathological staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected pathological_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: pathological_m_category
fields.description: Extent of distant metastasis (M), per the pathological staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected pathological_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: pathological_stage_group
fields.description: Overall pathological stage group assigned by the selected tumour staging system at specimen resection.

fields.name: tumour_grading_system
fields.description: Tumour grading system used to describe the tumour based on how abnormal the cells look under a microscope.

codeList: WHO grading system for CNS tumours

fields.name: tumour_grade
fields.description: Grade of the tumour as assigned by the reporting tumour_grading_system.

fields.name: percent_tumour_cells
fields.description: Proportion of tumour cells compared to total cells in the specimen (0.0–1.0).

fields.name: percent_tumour_cells_measurement_method
fields.description: Method used to measure percent_tumour_cells.

fields.name: percent_proliferating_cells
fields.description: Proportion of proliferating cells determined during pathologic review of the specimen (0.0–1.0).

fields.name: percent_inflammatory_tissue
fields.description: Proportion of the specimen positive for inflammatory markers (0.0–1.0).

fields.name: percent_stromal_cells
fields.description: Proportion of reactive non-malignant cells in the tumour specimen (0.0–1.0).

fields.name: percent_necrosis
fields.description: Proportion of cells undergoing necrosis in the tumour specimen (0.0–1.0).

fields.name: submitter_primary_diagnosis_id
fields.description: The primary diagnosis event this treatment is related to.

fields.name: treatment_type
fields.description: Type(s) of treatment regimen the donor received.

fields.name: is_primary_treatment
fields.description: Whether the treatment was the primary treatment following the initial diagnosis.

fields.name: line_of_treatment
fields.description: Line of treatment if it is not the primary treatment.

fields.name: treatment_start_interval
fields.description: Interval in days from primary diagnosis to start of treatment.

fields.name: treatment_duration
fields.description: Duration of treatment in days.

fields.name: days_per_cycle
fields.description: Number of days in a treatment cycle.

fields.name: number_of_cycles
fields.description: Number of treatment cycles.

fields.name: treatment_intent
fields.description: Purpose of the treatment, or the desired effect or outcome.

fields.name: treatment_setting
fields.description: Treatment's purpose in relation to the primary treatment.

fields.name: response_to_treatment_criteria_method
fields.description: Criteria used to assess the donor's response to the applied treatment regimen.

codeList: ELN Dohner AML 2017 Oncology Response Criteria
IWG Cheson AML 2003 Oncology Response Criteria

fields.name: response_to_treatment
fields.description: Donor's response to the applied treatment regimen.

codeList: Complete remission with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi)
Complete remission without minimal residual disease (CRMRD-)
Morphologic complete remission with incomplete blood count recovery (CRi)

fields.name: outcome_of_treatment
fields.description: Donor's outcome of the prescribed treatment.

codeList: Treatment incomplete due to technical or organizational problems
Treatment stopped due to lack of efficacy (disease progression)
Treatment stopped due to acute toxicity

fields.name: toxicity_type
fields.description: Whether early treatment termination due to acute toxicity was hematological or non-hematological.

fields.name: hematological_toxicity
fields.description: Hematological toxicities which caused early termination of the treatment.

fields.name: non_hematological_toxicity
fields.description: Non-hematological toxicities which caused early termination of the treatment.

fields.name: adverse_events
fields.description: Treatment-related adverse events.

fields.name: clinical_trials_database
fields.description: Clinical trial database where a clinical trial the donor participates in is registered.

fields.name: clinical_trial_number
fields.description: Unique NCT or EudraCT clinical trial identifier for the trial the donor participates in.

schemas.name: follow_up
schemas.description: A follow-up visit or contact with a donor after primary diagnosis.

fields.name: program_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the program this follow-up record belongs to.

fields.name: submitter_donor_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the donor within this program.

fields.name: submitter_follow_up_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this follow-up event within the donor record.

fields.name: interval_of_followup
fields.description: Interval in days from primary diagnosis to this follow-up.

fields.name: disease_status_at_followup
fields.description: Donor's disease status at the time of this follow-up.

fields.name: submitter_primary_diagnosis_id
fields.description: The primary diagnosis event this follow-up is associated with.

fields.name: submitter_treatment_id
fields.description: The treatment event this follow-up is associated with.

fields.name: weight_at_followup
fields.description: Donor weight in kilograms at the time of this follow-up.

fields.name: relapse_type
fields.description: Type of relapse or recurrence, when applicable.

fields.name: relapse_interval
fields.description: Days from primary diagnosis to relapse or recurrence.

fields.name: method_of_progression_status
fields.description: Method(s) used to confirm disease progression, relapse, or recurrence.

codeList: Biomarker in liquid biopsy (e.g. tumour marker in blood or urine)

fields.name: anatomic_site_progression_or_recurrence
fields.description: ICD-O-3 topography code(s) for the anatomic site(s) of disease progression or recurrence.

fields.name: recurrence_tumour_staging_system
fields.description: Tumour staging system used to stage the cancer at time of retreatment for recurrence or progression.

fields.name: recurrence_t_category
fields.description: Extent of the primary tumour (T) at time of retreatment, per the recurrence staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected recurrence_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: recurrence_n_category
fields.description: Regional lymph node involvement (N) at time of retreatment, per the recurrence staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected recurrence_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: recurrence_m_category
fields.description: Extent of distant metastasis (M) at time of retreatment, per the recurrence staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected recurrence_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: recurrence_stage_group
fields.description: Overall stage group assigned by the recurrence staging system.

fields.name: posttherapy_tumour_staging_system
fields.description: Tumour staging system used to stage the cancer after systemic or radiation therapy, or neoadjuvant therapy.

fields.name: posttherapy_t_category
fields.description: Extent of the primary tumour (T) after therapy, per the post-therapy staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected posttherapy_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: posttherapy_n_category
fields.description: Regional lymph node involvement (N) after therapy, per the post-therapy staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected posttherapy_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: posttherapy_m_category
fields.description: Extent of distant metastasis (M) after therapy, per the post-therapy staging system.

meta.notes: This field is required only if the selected posttherapy_tumour_staging_system is any edition of the AJCC cancer staging system.

fields.name: posttherapy_stage_group
fields.description: Overall stage group assigned by the post-therapy staging system.

schemas.name: exposure
schemas.description: Lifestyle and environmental exposure factors for a donor.

fields.name: program_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the program this exposure record belongs to.

fields.name: submitter_donor_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the donor within this program.

fields.name: tobacco_smoking_status
fields.description: Donor's self-reported tobacco smoking status and history.

codeList: Current reformed smoker, duration not specified
Lifelong non-smoker (<100 cigarettes smoked in lifetime)

fields.name: tobacco_type
fields.description: Type(s) of tobacco used by the donor.

fields.name: pack_years_smoked
fields.description: Cigarette smoking intensity in pack years (cigarettes per day × years smoked ÷ 20).

fields.name: alcohol_history
fields.description: Whether the donor has consumed at least 12 alcoholic drinks in their lifetime.

fields.name: alcohol_consumption_category
fields.description: Donor's current level of alcohol use.

codeList: Social Drinker (> once a month, < once a week)

fields.name: alcohol_type
fields.description: Type(s) of alcohol consumed by the donor.

fields.name: opiate_use
fields.description: Whether the donor has regularly used opiates (at least weekly over a 6-month period).

fields.name: hot_drinks_consumption
fields.description: Whether the donor regularly drinks hot beverages such as tea or coffee.

fields.name: red_meat_frequency
fields.description: Frequency of red meat consumption (e.g. beef, pork, lamb).

fields.name: processed_meat_frequency
fields.description: Frequency of processed meat consumption (e.g. ham, salami, sausage).

fields.name: soft_drinks_frequency
fields.description: Frequency of soft drink consumption.

fields.name: exercise_frequency
fields.description: How many times per week the donor exercises for at least 30 minutes.

fields.name: exercise_intensity
fields.description: Intensity of exercise sessions.

codeList: Low: No increase in the heart beat, and no perspiration
Moderate: Increase in the heart beat slightly with some light perspiration
Vigorous: Increase in the heart beat substantially with heavy perspiration

schemas.name: comorbidity
schemas.description: A medical condition present alongside or prior to the index disease for a donor.

fields.name: program_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the program this comorbidity record belongs to.

fields.name: submitter_donor_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the donor within this program.

fields.name: prior_malignancy
fields.description: Whether the comorbidity is a prior malignancy.

fields.name: laterality_of_prior_malignancy
fields.description: Laterality of the prior malignancy, when applicable.

fields.name: age_at_comorbidity_diagnosis
fields.description: Age of the donor in years at the time of comorbidity diagnosis.

fields.name: comorbidity_type_code
fields.description: WHO ICD-10 code for the comorbidity.

fields.name: comorbidity_treatment_status
fields.description: Whether the donor is currently receiving treatment for this comorbidity.

fields.name: comorbidity_treatment
fields.description: Description of treatment received for this comorbidity.
